name: Start Pos Anywhere
description: Start a level from any percentage, with start positions created from your own runs.

respawn-margin.name: Respawn safety margin
respawn-margin.description: In blocks. "Respawn" and the % slider stop this far before the furthest point you reached, which is usually where you died.

precise-mode.name: Precise mode
precise-mode.description: In practice mode, also records full checkpoints (triggers, moved blocks, colors, groups) and respawns from them. Only runs started from the real level start are recorded. Not saved between sessions.

precise-interval.name: Precise checkpoint interval
precise-interval.description: In blocks. Lower is closer to the % you pick, but uses more memory.

place-startpos.name: Place a start pos
place-startpos.description: Places a start position where you are, without stopping the run.

next-startpos.name: Next start pos
next-startpos.description: Restarts from the next manual start position.

prev-startpos.name: Previous start pos
prev-startpos.description: Restarts from the previous manual start position (or the level start).

delete-startpos.name: Delete start pos
delete-startpos.description: Deletes the active manual start position.

manual-min-gap.name: Minimum gap between start pos
manual-min-gap.description: In blocks. A new manual start position closer than this to another one is ignored. 0 = no limit.

debug-logs.name: Verbose logs
debug-logs.description: Writes the recording state to the Geode console every second. Only useful for debugging.
